name: services/instaddr/inst_address
description: Get information on a given institutional address.
brief_description: Get information on a given institutional address.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • Primary:

    • id - institutional address ID;

    • name - name of the institutional address (a LangDict object);

    • email - institutional address email;

    • faculty - faculty of the institutional address.

      This field references objects returned by services/fac/faculty method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

  • Secondary:

    • assigned_users - list of users that can send messages from this institutional address.

      This field references objects returned by services/users/user method. See its returns section for possible subfields.
errors: • object_not_found - institutional address could not be found; param_name is equal to inst_address_id.

result_fields.name: name
result_fields.description: name of the institutional address (a LangDict object)

result_fields.name: assigned_users
result_fields.description: list of users that can send messages from this institutional address
